caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #101: CURSORY

cursory (adjective): hasty and therefore not thorough.

✅ In a sentence: A cursory glance at the contract missed the hidden fees.
✅ Similar: hasty, superficial, perfunctory
✅ Remember it: Think "cursor": skimming quickly past.
